_meta.indication: ARISTADA is indicated for treatment of schizophrenia

pivotal_trials.trial_name: ALK9072-003 (referred to as Study 1 in the label)
pivotal_trials.design: 12-week, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, fixed-dose study; after establishing tolerability to oral aripiprazole, patients received oral aripiprazole or placebo daily for the first 3 weeks, with IM injections on Days 1, 29 and 57
pivotal_trials.population: Adult patients 18 to 70 years of age with schizophrenia (DSM-IV TR), PANSS total score of 70 to 120, experiencing an acute exacerbation of symptoms
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Change from baseline to endpoint (Day 85) in PANSS total score
pivotal_trials.result: Placebo-subtracted PANSS total score change: ARISTADA 441 mg -10.9 (95% CI -14.5, -7.3); ARISTADA 882 mg -11.9 (95% CI -15.4, -8.3); both statistically significant vs placebo

nct_ctgov.title: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of ALKS 9072 (Also Known as Aripiprazole Lauroxil, ALKS 9070, or ARISTADA) in Subjects With Schizophrenia

key_safety: Most common adverse reaction (incidence >=5% and at least twice placebo) was akathisia (11% at both 441 mg and 882 mg vs 4% placebo). Other reactions >=2% include headache (882 mg 5% vs 3% placebo), injection site pain (3-4% vs 2%), and insomnia (3-4% vs 2%). Serious class risks: increased mortality in elderly dementia patients, cerebrovascular adverse reactions, neuroleptic malignant syndrome, tardive dyskinesia, and metabolic changes.
target_moa: ARISTADA is a prodrug of aripiprazole; efficacy could be mediated through a combination of partial agonist activity at D2 and 5-HT1A receptors and antagonist activity at 5-HT2A receptors. Aripiprazole exhibits high affinity for dopamine D2 and D3, serotonin 5-HT1A and 5-HT2A receptors.
modality: Small molecule (aripiprazole lauroxil, a prodrug of aripiprazole) formulated as an extended-release injectable suspension for intramuscular use

boxed_warning.content: Increased mortality in elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis: such patients treated with antipsychotic drugs are at an increased risk of death. ARISTADA is not approved for the treatment of patients with dementia-related psychosis.

advisory_committee.vote: Not referred to an FDA advisory committee because this drug is not the first in its class

description.text: Added a higher 1064 mg strength enabling a every-2-month dosing interval

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental new drug application provides for a higher strength (1064 mg dose) of ARISTADA that extends the dosing interval to every 2 months.

summary.text: ARISTADA was approved October 5, 2015 as a 505(b)(2) NDA relying on the Agency's previous findings of safety and efficacy for Abilify (aripiprazole) Tablets. Efficacy was established in a single Phase 3 trial (ALK9072-003) plus pharmacokinetic bridging to oral aripiprazole. The application was not referred to an advisory committee because the drug is not first in its class; pediatric study requirements were waived.

citations.quote: This application was submitted as a 505(b)(2) NDA relying on the Agency's previous findings of safety and efficacy for Abilify (aripiprazole) Tablets (NDA 21436).
Your application for Aristada was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because this drug is not the first in its class.

We are waiving the pediatric study requirement for this application because necessary studies are impossible or highly impracticable. It is not feasible to conduct an adequate study of the safety and efficacy of aripiprazole lauroxil in a sufficient number of pediatric patients with schizophrenia due to the low prevalence, and the diagnostic difficulties and complexities in this population.
